We can run a focused 60-minute technical session and will cover: deployment modes (hosted private VPC vs dedicated on-prem appliance), network/topology patterns (peering, private endpoints), KMS/HSM workflows, and recommended fallbacks for air-gapped sites.

From our side, the following windows look feasible (all ET):
- Wed Nov 4, 14:00–15:00 (preferred)
- Thu Nov 5, 09:00–10:00

Laura (Engineering lead) and Jordan (Solutions) are cc'd to confirm resource availability. I'll also circulate a brief agenda and a pre-read security checklist before the call.

Questions for you before we lock:
1) Will your on-prem environment allow an outbound-only egress proxy for periodic updates, or must it be fully air-gapped?
2) Do you have a preferred HSM vendor (Thales/HashiCorp/Cloud KMS)?

I'll attach our proposed agenda now (DEEPDIVE_AGENDA_v1.docx).
